scope: Adds and exercises a backend-neutral opt-in router-logits plugin ABI with a reference CPU implementation and an external OpenVINO NPU implementation. It does not integrate the plugin into Strata model generation.

findings: The archived YAML optimizer matches a module and imports an explicit replacement Python class path with per-stage generate/prefill devices and operations.
Current KT-Kernel validates a method string and maps it to a specific wrapper/backend implementation rather than treating a device as a global graph replacement.
The inspected tree has Ascend NPU integration, but no Intel OpenVINO/NPU backend was found.

checks.name: macos-plugin-abi
checks.result: The dynamic loader accepted ABI 1, loaded reference-cpu, executed the BF16 router, and all logits matched the CPU reference with max_abs_error 0. The failure paths rejected a nonexistent library path and invalid router dimensions.

checks.name: openvino-npu-boundaries
results: A BF16 INFERENCE_PRECISION_HINT request failed because this NPU configuration supports f16 and i8, not bf16.
A dynamic first-dimension graph failed NPU compilation with 'Missing upper bound for one or more nodes'.
After explicit BF16-to-F16 conversion and a static one-token graph, set_input_tensor/set_output_tensor worked.

non_claims: No Strata model-generation path, CLI, or server invokes the plugin ABI yet.
The NPU result does not establish useful routing performance, especially because one synchronous execution measured 25.189 ms.
No same-day CUDA/CPU router control, transfer accounting, repeated-run latency distribution, or real-model output comparison was run.
The OpenVINO plugin is not built by default and has not been compiled on Windows or against another OpenVINO release.
The K-Transformers inspection is pinned to one upstream commit and does not import or endorse its code for Strata.
